newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma buoyant, depos, forwards, bonds stable.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma buoyant, depos, forwards, bonds stable.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was keeping its firm tone hugging 310.50 in late dealings after coming off an intraday high of 310.70 and depos, forex forwards and bonds were little changed, dealers said.

"Ecu/drachma is hovering around 310 in late trade," said a forex trader at a foreign bank. "It has been firm all day long and got stronger after the central bank did little to stem the ecu's rise at the fixing."
The dealer said the central bank checked mark/drachma during intraday trade when ecu/drachma was around 310.40 but sold just a token amount of 5.0 million ecus at the fixing.
"I think the central bank wanted some players who were short ecus to buy them at a higher price at the fixing," the dealer said.

Some forex traders said Bank of Greece was willing to see ecu/drachma at high levels, perhaps well above 310, because it wanted to sell ecus and dollars for drachmas on three forex-linked government loans expiring on May 17 at higher prices.
"The central bank wants to sell ecus and dollars for drachmas at higher prices," said a forex trader.
But other traders disagreed and said it was not known whether investors had funded their forex-linked Greek government loans through drachmas or foreign exchange.
Depos, forex forwards and bonds were trading narrowly in late dealings, traders said.
The central bank said it will cut its discount, Lombard and overdraft rates by 100 basis rates to 14.5 percent, 19 percent and 24 percent effective May 13.
It justified its decision by citing falling inflation and the need to bring the rates closer to interbank rates.
The mark was quoted at 159.76/81 from Monday's 159.930 fix, the dollar at 270.49/59 drachmas from 270.500 and the ecu at 310.48/58 from 310.520 drachmas.
